Material Icon Theme — license and provenance
=============================================

The file-type icons in app/assets/file-icons/ are vendored from the Material Icon
Theme. They live under resources/ so this notice ships with the packaged app:
electron-builder.yml includes resources/** and excludes app/**.

Upstream: material-extensions/vscode-material-icon-theme
Tag:      v5.40.0
Icons:    commit e8982b8
